Self.Wiki: This map object represents a Talk ESD setup within the map.

EnemyPartNames.Wiki: [0] is the main character of the setup; [1] to [3] are the characters that speak Talk ID [0] to [2].

TalkEntries.Wiki: The talk ESD spoken by Character Name [1] to [3] (one entry each). 0 for none.

Unk44.Wiki: A value read with Talk ID [0]. 1 on most setups, else 0, 3 or 7.

Unk45.Wiki: The same value for Talk ID [1]. 0, 1 or 4 in the game files.

Unk46.Wiki: The same value for Talk ID [2]. 0, or 3 once.
